## PluginPanelsAppContext

Public SDK type, exported as `PluginPanelsAppContext`. Import with `import type`; the SDK has no runtime exports.

```ts
export interface PluginPanelsAppContext {
    openSessionPanel(sessionId: string, panelId: string): void;
    closeSessionPanel(sessionId: string): void;
}
```

**Member index** (including nested object members; inherited members are defined in the linked base types):

- [openSessionPanel](#pluginpanelsappcontext-opensessionpanel)
- [closeSessionPanel](#pluginpanelsappcontext-closesessionpanel)

### PluginPanelsAppContext openSessionPanel

Open this plugin's panel for a session (persisted, so it also applies when
that session is viewed later). Replaces any other open panel there.

```ts
openSessionPanel(sessionId: string, panelId: string): void;
```

| Parameter | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | `string` |
| `panelId` | `string` |

**Returns:** `void`.

### PluginPanelsAppContext closeSessionPanel

Close whichever panel is open for the session.

```ts
closeSessionPanel(sessionId: string): void;
```

| Parameter | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | `string` |

**Returns:** `void`.

## PluginPanelsFrontendContext

Public SDK type, exported as `PluginPanelsFrontendContext`. Import with `import type`; the SDK has no runtime exports.

```ts
export interface PluginPanelsFrontendContext {
    registerSessionPanel(panel: PluginSessionPanel): () => void;
}
```

**Related types:** [PluginSessionPanel](plugin-panels.md#pluginsessionpanel).

**Member index** (including nested object members; inherited members are defined in the linked base types):

- [registerSessionPanel](#pluginpanelsfrontendcontext-registersessionpanel)

### PluginPanelsFrontendContext registerSessionPanel

Offer a panel beside session transcripts. One panel is open at a time per
session; several offered panels show as host tabs. Invalid/duplicate ids
throw. Returns unregister, which closes and aborts its mounts.

```ts
registerSessionPanel(panel: PluginSessionPanel): () => void;
```

| Parameter | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `panel` | `PluginSessionPanel` |

**Returns:** `() => void`.

## PluginSessionPanel

Public SDK type, exported as `PluginSessionPanel`. Import with `import type`; the SDK has no runtime exports.

```ts
export interface PluginSessionPanel {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    icon?: string;
    sessions?: ("teaching" | "practice")[];
    defaultWidth?: number;
    minWidth?: number;
    mount(container: HTMLElement, context: PluginSessionPanelContext): void | PluginCleanup | Promise<void | PluginCleanup>;
}
```

### PluginSessionPanel id

Route-safe id, unique within this plugin.

```ts
id: string;
```

### PluginSessionPanel title

Tab label and accessible name.

```ts
title: string;
```

### PluginSessionPanel icon

Trusted plugin SVG markup for the tab.

```ts
icon?: string;
```

### PluginSessionPanel sessions

Session kinds offering this panel; omitted means both.

```ts
sessions?: ("teaching" | "practice")[];
```

### PluginSessionPanel defaultWidth

Initial width in CSS px (default 360). The learner's resize persists per session and panel.

```ts
defaultWidth?: number;
```

### PluginSessionPanel minWidth

Smallest resize width in CSS px (default 240).

```ts
minWidth?: number;
```

### PluginSessionPanel mount

Mount the panel body; return sync/async cleanup.

### PluginSessionPanelContext signal

Aborted when the session view is left, the panel is closed or switched,
the panel is unregistered or the plugin is disabled. Turns and streaming
do not remount the panel.

```ts
readonly signal: AbortSignal;
```
